_about: Every value in this file is ASSUMED (not on the AFTER O.C. sheet). Change a value and re-run tools/build_model.py to regenerate the model. See docs/drawing-takeoff.md Q2, Q6, Q7, Q10, Q11.

furniture_sizes._note: Wakefit models chosen by the family (sizes confirmed by the family). Bedside table 0.40x0.40 ASSUMED (as in the CozyStays Bella Vita photo). Heights ASSUMED.

clearances._note: Single occupancy, queen bed: 0.60 m on both long sides where it fits (otherwise reported). Wardrobe front 0.60 m (hinged doors). Desk chair zone 0.75 m. Walking path 0.55 m. All ASSUMED except the family's ROOM-4 rule.
clearances._room4_rule: F1-3 ROOM-4 (family): queen bed with one long side against a wall, Tinker side table on the open side touching the head wall; study wall = west wall (x 4.45) with the study table and the wardrobe.
clearances._sofa_note: Sofa: 1'-5 3/4" (0.45 m) legroom in front (ASSUMED). Bed mode (4'-0" deep) needs the front clear to 4'-0" from the wall - reported, not required.

doors._note: hinge = plan point; zone = quarter-disc of radius 'width' swept from the hinge into 'quadrant' (signs of dx, dy). ALL doors open INWARDS (family instruction): room doors into rooms, toilet/WC doors into the toilet, terrace door into the suite. Arcs DRAWN on F4 room doors; hinge sides elsewhere ASSUMED, chosen so the open leaf lies against a side wall.
